about: Budgets for one style pack piece by look family, at its first level of detail and as one binary glTF file. A piece is an exulanica.static-glb/v1 container first; these sit on top of that profile's container limits. A tiled family's triangles are per metre of the piece's own width. A second level of detail holds at most lod1_share_permille of the first's triangles. Set from one composed market town's part counts (34 buildings, 156 facades, about 618 window openings, 220 ground bays, 78 fixtures, 32 trees, 87 rooftop objects) so that every part dressed at its budget stays inside a frame.
